api.boundary: Shippin panel talks only to this contract. It does not embed the upstream core's UI. Secret values never appear in catalog GET or lesson payloads. Upstream wire paths live only in panel/internal/core/wire.go.

routes.purpose: Create a tenant/project (idempotent on tenant id)
Put a secret value; response is metadata only
Issue a short-lived inject handle for a workspace/DevForge run
Lesson ids the panel plays on the Lovable-to-vibe path
Deployed Vaultix instances for the overview: name, host, health, secret count, last backup. Metadata only
Set or change the per-user per-instance PIN; change requires the current PIN, recovery goes through Authentik re-auth
Verify per-user PIN inside an Authentik session; mint short-lived (~15 min) elevated session for one instance. Rate-limited, audited
Link an external migration source (source: infisical during beta); read-scoped credential stored encrypted server-side
Link status and last import time; never returns the credential
Run or re-run the one-way import from the linked source into Vaultix
Unlink: delete stored credential, stop imports. Never touches the source side

upstream.name: Infisical
upstream.note: See docs/0001-mit-core-and-name.md. Do not ship Infisical ee/ as Vaultix.

readinessGates: Dedicated host (not the 1 GB Oracle box; not piled onto Zuul without RAM headroom)
MIT-core compose branded Vaultix at vaultix.shippin.cloud
Export path from Infisical Cloud documented and tested
Panel adapter never returns secret values on GET
